PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?x ?n WHERE { ?x foaf:name ?n } ORDER BY ?n
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?a ?n WHERE { ?a foaf:knows ?b . ?b foaf:name ?n } ORDER BY ?n
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?x WHERE { ?x foaf:age ?a FILTER(?a > 40) }
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?n (LANG(?n) AS ?l) WHERE { ?x foaf:name ?n FILTER(LANGMATCHES(LANG(?n), "en")) } ORDER BY ?n
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?x ?a WHERE { ?x foaf:name ?n OPTIONAL { ?x foaf:age ?a } } ORDER BY ?a
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?x WHERE { ?x foaf:name ?n FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?x foaf:age ?a } }
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?p (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } GROUP BY ?p ORDER BY ?p
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> CONSTRUCT { ?b foaf:knownBy ?a } WHERE { ?a foaf:knows ?b }
